call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth target deferred to end-September; management says it will grow but won't quantify.
Aim is to sustain ~15% operating EBITDA margin, not expand it, despite price hikes.
Tower crane capacity already raised to about 1,000 cranes via a rented nearby premises; expansion decision deferred to September.
Defence expected at 5-6% and exports 6-7% of FY27 revenue, together 10-12%.
Anti-dumping duty on imported cranes was recommended by DGTR but not implemented by the Finance Ministry; no leads since.
Deficient monsoon can swing business 5-10%, visible in Q3 of the same year.
Tower crane demand remains full throttle, with order books full heading into the monsoon season.
Management expects to dynamically manage EBITDA margins in the 15% to 16% range excluding other income.
Total capex for FY27 is projected at approximately ₹200 crore, including land and a new defense plant.
ACE holds over 63% domestic market share in mobile cranes and around 60% in tower cranes.
End-user exposure is led by manufacturing and logistics at ~45%, followed by infrastructure at ~35%, real estate at ~13%, and agriculture at ~7%.
Operating margin expansion in FY26 was supported by product mix, better price realisations, and benign commodity prices.
Management stated the company achieved its highest ever quarterly revenue in Q4FY26.
Sales network spans over 125 domestic locations and exports to more than 37 countries globally.
Introduced next-generation cranes equipped with AI-integrated safety features (SCOS, ALSS, RAS) and clutchless transmission.
Management noted focus on profitable volume-led growth amid geopolitical uncertainty and input cost volatility.

operating_notes.text: Heavy Cranes Business comprises manufacturing of truck cranes, crawler cranes, and rough terrain cranes.
Deconsolidated subsidiary SC Forma SA during FY26, receiving net consideration of ₹14.34 Cr.
Mobile cranes market share domestic at >63%, tower cranes market share at ~60%.
End-user sector exposure: Manufacturing & Logistics ~45%, Infrastructure ~35%, Real Estate ~13%, Agriculture ~7%.
Steel price increases of 20-22% from January have prompted company-wide price hikes of 11-14%.
Exports were close to 3% and defence around 5% of Q1FY27 revenue; Middle East (Saudi Arabia) orders pending from March could not be shipped.
Hydra pick-and-carry cranes were a little less than 60% and new-generation cranes a little more than 40% of industry volumes last year; ACE expects 60-40 this year.
Backhoe loaders averaged close to 150-160 units a quarter; data centres contribute about 1.5-2% of revenue.

timeline.summary: Board approved execution of Business Transfer Agreement to transfer Heavy Cranes Business to 50:50 JV ACE KATO Private Limited via slump sale by June 30, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,029.49 Cr (+7.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹110.91 Cr (-6.5% YoY).
Released Q4FY26 / FY26 earnings presentation outlining >63% mobile crane market share, 18 working capital days, and KATO JV strategic rationale.
Action Construction Equipment Limited shared the Q4 FY 2025-26 conference call audio link on May 21, 2026, signed by **Anil Kumar** (Chairman & Managing Director).
Action Construction Equipment reported its Q4FY26 earnings call transcript outlining robust tower crane demand, price hikes to counter steel inflation, and a 50:50 JV with KATO.

On its 21 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, ACE reported best-ever Q1 total income of ₹836 Cr (+19% YoY) and PAT of ₹118.59 Cr (+22.47%), deferred its FY27 revenue growth target to end-September, and said the KATO JV would become functional by end-July with meaningful revenue only from FY28.
Action Construction Equipment Limited schedules a conference call on Friday, 13 November 2026 at 04:00 PM IST.
